description: Interior of a Victorian pawnbroker's shop. A dark wooden counter with an iron grille and a thick ledger book on it, a glass display case of rings, brooches and pocket watches, wall shelves crowded with clocks, candlesticks, a violin and small boxes, and a heavy black iron safe in the corner. Dim warm lamplight, timber panelling and a barred window on the back wall. Isometric 2:1 pixel art interior cutaway room seen from above at the front: one floor and two back walls only (a left wall and a right wall meeting at the back corner), no roof and no front walls. Floor edges and wall bases run along true 2:1 isometric axes (26.565 degrees). The entrance threshold at the front edge of the floor is open and clear, with a clear walkable floor area in the middle of the room. Warm morning light from the windows. No people, no animals, no readable text or letters. Detailed pixel art matching the reference's pixel style.
